traits.description: Values truth above all; unlikely to lie.
Driven by tithes, gold, and hidden wealth.
Keeps cards close to chest; hides past sins.
Wants to rise to Abbot or higher status at any cost.
Suspicious of demonic influence or secret plots.
Extremely devoted to strict monastic dogma.
Acts on sudden emotional triggers without confession.
Resents other brothers for holy favor or sacred items.
Holds long grudges over ancient abbey disputes.
Overindulges in food, wine, and material comforts.
Prone to deep sorrow, quiet brooding, and isolation.
Aggressively militant about enforcing monastic rules on others.
Frightened easily by conflict, threats, or danger.
